thread:
Ava (Marketing PM): Quick sync — I'm iterating on the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy for the next launch. Want a compact experiment plan: headline variants, one-liners, CTA matrix, and routing for leads. Can folks drop quick options?
Rory (Content): Cool — thinking 3 headline directions: performance-first, cost-control, and enterprise trust. Short examples: "Predictable inference at scale" / "Cut token costs with smart serving" / "Private deployments, enterprise controls"
Sam (Growth): Love it. For CTAs we should map to intent: try hosted (Playground) -> "Try hosted API"; enterprise intent -> "Talk to sales"; evals/net-new customers -> "Run benchmark". Also propose different form flows for Dedicated vs Private (sales-assist for Private).
Lee (Product): Make sure each headline ties to a single measurable claim: latency, $/1k tokens, and compliance. Eg: "< 100ms p95 for short-chat" ; "Up to 3x token cost reduction with prefix caching" ; "VPC + KMS integration for SOC2 workloads"
Jorge (Design): For landing layout, keep hero small bullets + one-line metric chips under CTA. Visual cue to switch mode (hosted/dedicated/private) with tiny toggle so copy can mutate without new page.
Ava (Marketing PM): Nice. Who can draft the 2ndary lines under each headline? Need ~10 words each, with one proof + one user outcome. Example: "Host: Instant API access — ship features faster, $-tracked usage."
Rory (Content): Drafts: Hosted: "Instant API access for devs — low-lift integration, usage-based pricing." Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools — predictable throughput and isolation." Private: "Customer-managed control plane — VPC & key management for regulated apps.
Sam (Growth): Routing notes: use utm=hero_mode and param mode=hosted|dedicated|private on CTAs. For hosted -> /signup?mode=hosted. For dedicated/private -> /sales?mode=dedicated (pre-populate form: expected qps, compliance reqs). Also add a "benchmark" CTA that links to our benchmark blog with utm=benchmark_launch.
Ava (Marketing PM): Can we add a short benchmark blurb in hero on launch day? Maybe one stat: "< 100ms p95 on common chat loads" plus link to details. Needs product signoff.
Lee (Product): I can sign off if wording is precise. Suggest: "p95 latency <100ms on 8k context chat (sample workload). See full benchmark." Link to /benchmarks/launch-post. Also add fallback copy for regions without Dedicated.
Rory (Content): For the launch post narrative, angle = serving-first thesis: shift from model ownership to serving economics. Short lead: "Models evolve fast; predictable inference makes features reliable and cheap." Then use customer vignettes.
Sam (Growth): Webinar tie-in: "Serve Better: engineering panel on real LLM costs" — capture signups from hero via secondary CTA "Join webinar". We can auto-route registrants to sales if they selected Dedicated/Private on form.
Jorge (Design): Will make wire for hero with 3 micro-CTAs (Try hosted / Request dedicated quote / Book private demo). Low-contrast secondary for webinar.
Ava (Marketing PM): Action items: Rory to finalize microcopy by EOD tomorrow, Lee to confirm bench stat + link, Sam to wire up UTMs & form flows, Jorge to drop hero comps. I'll collate and run a quick CRO test matrix (headline A/B x CTA variation).
Lee (Product): Quick note: bench stat must include test config. I'll paste snippet to repo and ping once done.
Sam (Growth): Ping on the UTM pattern I suggested: `?utm_source=site&utm_medium=hero&utm_campaign=launch&utm_content=hosted` — we should standardize.
Ava (Marketing PM): Perfect. @channel if anyone else has objections to the routing or wants to add a variant shout now. Otherwise we'll roll with it and spin up the A/B in two weeks. :rocket: 
deploy-bot: New staging build deployed for marketing site (build #421).
Rory (Content): :thumbsup: I'll push drafts and drop a link in this thread.
Sam (Growth): Adding tracking doc link: https://docs.internal/marketing/launch-tracking (will update permissions).
Ava (Marketing PM): Thanks team — will circle back after drafts.
